mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST show positive month-over-month changes, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO declines for 2 consecutive months), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 225, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 signals a severe contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 90, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units signals weak residential demand, which may lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or Rank IC for joint condition falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
